dialogue-en-5.text: Flashpoints offer moments of emotional choice. How Aloy expresses her personality is up to you.
Choose and Aloy will Confront the challenge directly.
Choose and Aloy will use her Insight to find a clever, less obvious approach.
Choose and Aloy will express Compassion or give voice to her deepest convictions.
Someone who doesn't have time for this
Someone who had no other choice
Someone who had a good reason

dialogue-en-6.text: Well-worn armor made with repurposed technology from an ancient lab. After losing its power source, it was modified to augment ranged combat.

dialogue-en-7.text: Sign in for 7 days consecutively to get the 5-star Operator "Cliffheart". Your progress will be reset if you miss a sign-in day. Previous rewards cannot be claimed again.

dialogue-en-13.text: But my sisters were always with me. I felt bad for bothering them and for all the worry I caused them, but I was really happy that I wasn't left alone.

dialogue-en-14.text: Finally opened up after that incident, the idiot broke my counter, with his head...

dialogue-en-15.text: Morning, Ella. Sometimes I wonder if I'm in the right place — all this hauling back-and-forth gets tiresome and, quite frankly, I'm upset at it more than I should be... but I have the right to be angry!
